div.p: This case-sensitive code system https://www.medizininformatik-initiative.de/fhir/ext/modul-icu/CodeSystem/mii-cs-icu-dgai defines the following codes:
Sophia Observation withdrawal Symptoms-scale (SOS). This profile covers withdrawal symptoms. For pediatric delirium use MII_PR_ICU_Score_SOS_PD.

Sophia Observation withdrawal Symptoms-scale and Pediatric Delirium (SOS-PD). This profile covers only the pediatric delirium assessment score, although the instrument also includes SOS. Parental behavioural assessment is not captured. For withdrawal symptoms use MII_PR_ICU_Score_SOS.
Confusion Assessment Method for the ICU (CAM-ICU)
Assessment of whether a contraindication to enteral nutrition is present or absent; the code itself does not assert its presence.
Assessment of whether a contraindication to prone positioning is present or absent; the code itself does not assert its presence.
Assessment of whether a contraindication to pharmacological thromboprophylaxis is present or absent; the code itself does not assert its presence. Mechanical thromboprophylaxis is outside its scope.

Assessment of whether parenteral nutrition is actually being administered at the effective time or throughout the effective period; the code identifies the assessment question and does not itself assert that administration is in progress. This is not an order, indication or contraindication assessment.

description.value: Placeholder codes for intensive care concepts without an established international code (drafts only).
